prompt:
No host, no woman, no Victoria, no presenter portrait. Без лица ведущей. Животные, объекты и типографика.
Master 3:4 @ 4K, сетка 3x3 из 9 панелей 3:4, row-major 01–09.
Стиль: animals_viktoria_collage. Графит #111111–#18181b, маджента #ff006e, белый #ffffff, золото.
Сетка: slice_method seam, тонкие белые желоба (thin white gutters) на 1/3 и 2/3. Отступы ≥12% от линий реза и краёв. Текст не у нижнего края.
Типографика: verbatim-текст, без лишних надписей, без подписи Victoria. Крупный белый гротеск, рукописный маджента.

Панели 01–09:
01 (hook): "You stopped texting first. 4 days. The chat died.". Alert cat, dark screen, magenta tape.
02 (problem): "The pain isn't silence, it's who carried it" / "All along, this bond existed purely on your fuel. The second you let go of the wheel, the car simply stopped moving.". Dog by screen.
03 (mistake): "The trap: «Maybe he's just really busy?»" / "You make excuses and itch to reach out again. But being busy is never four whole days without a single syllable.". Dog, tape pill.
04 (mechanism): "He doesn't dislike you. He's a passenger" / "He is happy to ride along as long as you buy the gas and drive. But he won't take a single step to make things happen.". Cat on divide.
05 (save_decoder): "Replying vs Initiating: The honest test" / "«Replies to texts» → Polite passivity. «Sends random memes» → Bored in line. «Asks to see you» → He actually wants you.". Owl, mirror frame.
06 (save_checklist): "3 signs your chat is on life support" / "1. Without your prompt, the chat freezes for days. 2. Future plans are always «sometime soon». 3. His warmth only exists in your questions.". Owl, checklist.
07 (save_rule): "Never remind someone who's fine without you" / "He is perfectly at ease without hearing your voice. Take your energy back to where it builds your life, not his comfort.". Cat at window.
08 (recap): "True reciprocity doesn't need CPR" / "If a bond only survives when you keep pumping air into it, it's not a relationship. It's a monologue at a closed door.". Owl witness.
09 (cta): "Comment MIRROR" / "Audio reading in my app." / "Write MIRROR in the comments". Handwritten "MIRROR" magenta, dark mirror, tarot glyphs.
